# MLBB Boost

> Independent service for arranging Mobile Legends: Bang Bang rank boosts and party play. Not affiliated with MOONTON Games.

Orders are arranged through Telegram. Estimates use public API base rates in RUB; first-order discount eligibility and timing must be confirmed before payment. Account access carries risks; no guarantee of no sanctions. Published reviews are not independently certified.
